title: Isolated marker fixture
objective: Exercise the role gates and merge reconciliation on a disposable Git repository with a fixture PR provider.
inScope: Commit the fixture marker and exercise the inherited local workflow.
outOfScope: Live GitHub, historical canary state, and live review judgments.
acceptanceCriteria: The marker is validated at the exact fixture revision and the simulated merge reconciles once.
validationPlan: Run the fixture build and test commands and exercise independent gate inputs.
